code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid color-2 line is the boundary; move the object up against it,
    # then mark the full line immediately beyond the object with color 8.
    line_color = 2
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == line_color for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h))]
    if row_lines:
        line = row_lines[0]
        obj = next(v for v in {x for row in grid for x in row} if v not in (line_color, max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))))
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
        rmin, rmax = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        delta = (line + 1 - rmin) if rmin > line else (line - 1 - rmax)
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        moved = [(r+delta,c) for r,c in cells]
        for r,c in moved: out[r][c] = obj
        mark = max(r for r,c in moved)+1 if rmin > line else min(r for r,c in moved)-1
        if 0 <= mark < h: out[mark] = [8]*w
    elif col_lines:
        line = col_lines[0]
        bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        obj = next(v for v in {x for row in grid for x in row} if v not in (line_color,bg))
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
        cmin,cmax=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
        delta = line+1-cmin if cmin>line else line-1-cmax
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
        moved=[(r,c+delta) for r,c in cells]
        for r,c in moved: out[r][c]=obj
        mark=max(c for r,c in moved)+1 if cmin>line else min(c for r,c in moved)-1
        for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
    return out
'''
